features.title: Features that Make a Difference
features.subtitle: Discover how we make parcel management simple and efficient
features.heading: Your Parcels, Our Priority — Seamless, Secure, Smart.
features.description: At MySafari Parcel, we're committed to delivering a seamless, secure, and smart experience — whether you're sending, tracking, managing, or building a delivery business.
features.tagline: Here's how we make it simple for you:

realTimeTracking.title: Real-Time Parcel Tracking
realTimeTracking.description: Track your parcels every step of the way with live location updates and real-time delivery status. Stay informed from dispatch to doorstep — no guesswork, just certainty.

parcelHistory.title: Complete Parcel History
parcelHistory.description: Access a complete record of your parcel activities whenever you need it. Search past shipments, review delivery statuses, and download reports to keep your operations running smoothly.

notifications.title: Instant Notifications
notifications.description: Get real-time alerts via SMS or email about your parcel's movement. Whether it's out for delivery or successfully delivered, you'll always be in the loop.

security.title: Secure Access
security.description: Your security is our priority. Our platform uses secure authentication protocols to protect your data and ensure that only you have access to your parcel information.

dashboard.title: Comprehensive Management Dashboard
dashboard.description: Simplify your logistics. Our intuitive dashboard lets you manage multiple parcels, monitor delivery progress, and make data-driven decisions to optimize your operations.

agentNetwork.title: Join the MySafari Agents Network
agentNetwork.description: Expand your reach and grow your business with the MySafari Agents Network. Offer trusted parcel services in your community and earn commissions — backed by the MySafari Parcel brand.

slide2.description: Accept payments in multiple currencies and protect your parcels with comprehensive insurance coverage across all deliveries.

slide3.description: Currently serving East Africa with expansion across SADC region. Our vision: seamless parcel delivery across the entire African continent.
slide3.feature1: Active in Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda & Rwanda
slide3.feature2: Expanding to Zambia, Malawi & South Africa

slide4.title: Cross-Border Delivery Made Simple
slide4.description: Expand your reach across borders with seamless international parcel delivery and automated customs integration.
slide4.feature3: Duty & tax calculation with transparent pricing

slide5.title: Built for African Logistics
slide5.description: Experience technology designed specifically for African logistics challenges, from urban centers to remote rural areas.
